mapper.delete: delete from t_camera_screen where user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.update:
update t_camera_screen a a.user_id = #{userId}, a.screen_num = #{screenNum}, a.camera_ids = #{cameraIds}, a.create_time=CURRENT_TIME (),
where a.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select a.user_id, a.screen_num, a.camera_ids, a.create_time from t_camera_screen a where 1 = 1 and a.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1
mapper.insert:
insert into t_camera_screen( user_id, screen_num, camera_ids, create_time )values
( #{TCameraScreen.userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TCameraScreen.screenNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCameraScreen.cameraIds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCameraScreen.createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id where 1=1 and d.camera_name like CONCAT('%',#{cameraName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'));
